persisted_caller.source: Lockspire.Protocol.ClientAuth.authenticate/3 with Repository client, replay, and policy stores

LEG175-HASH-MISMATCH.migration_readiness: not_ready; no per-request hash check was introduced

persisted_caller.assertion_jtis: fresh unique values per attempt; omitted from this record

clocks.plug_storage_timestamp: authenticated signed_at seconds are encoded to milliseconds and checked against Plug wall clock
clocks.client_lifecycle: separately controlled injected decision clock; equality expiry is inclusive

authenticated_metadata_ranges.timestamp: integer milliseconds only; producer timestamp seconds are represented as signed_ms = seconds * 1000
authenticated_metadata_ranges.finite_max_age: positive numeric seconds; fractional 0.5 is interpreted as 500ms
authenticated_metadata_ranges.nonpositive_max_age: 0 and -1 are unsupported migration deadlines and Plug rejects them as expired
authenticated_metadata_ranges.infinity: preserved as infinity but not a bounded migration deadline; Plug accepts future timestamps when infinity is configured

explicit_unsupported_inputs: infinite age for a bounded migration deadline
metadata_reader.recovery: Keep unsupported rows unchanged and use authorized secret rotation/reprovision; never reset age or decode unauthenticated bytes.

policy_disposition.current_legacy_semantics: Plug.Crypto 2.2.1 finite storage age rejects future timestamps; age expiry occurs only when signed_ms + max_age_ms is strictly less than Plug wall clock
policy_disposition.configured_lifecycle_semantics: client and secret deadlines reject at equality using the injected lifecycle decision clock
policy_disposition.migrated_row_recommendation: preserve authenticated original finite deadline; a usable 23-hour row does not receive a reset deadline
policy_disposition.native_dedicated_recommendation: configured credential lifetime, approved by the owner through 175-POLICY-REVISION.md on 2026-10-25 before dependent planning
policy_disposition.within_approved_policy_basis: The boolean retains the result against the original pre-revision D-20 policy; this approved revision is separately identified by approved_revision_ref.

owner_approval.source: Explicit owner response received by the Phase 175 execution orchestrator
owner_approval.scope: Native dedicated verifier follows authoritative configured client-secret lifetime, including nil/0 and v0-unlimited beyond 24 hours; migrated legacy material preserves its authenticated original finite deadline and Plug equality-valid/strict-after-expiry behavior; unsupported future, malformed, tampered, wrong-key, unsupported-shape and unbounded migration-age rows remain rejected unchanged with authorized rotation/reprovision recovery.
owner_approval.limits: No algorithm, dependency, schema, or other authentication default changes; no production implementation, publication, deployment, or cleanup authorized.

native_age_policy.disposition: Owner-approved D-20 revision (2026-10-25): native dedicated verifier validity follows authoritative configured client-secret lifetime, while client-app expiry remains separate; configured nil/0 and v0-unlimited clients may remain eligible beyond 24 hours. Migrated legacy material preserves its authenticated original finite deadline and equality-valid/strict-after-expiry boundary. Future, malformed, tampered, wrong-key, unsupported-shape and unbounded migration-age inputs remain unsupported and unchanged. Evidence observes the current callers; approval selects the future policy but does not claim runtime implementation.
native_age_policy.recovery: Existing authorized secret rotation/reprovision path; no opaque rewrap or age reset.

public_metadata_reader.disposition: Public authenticated decrypt plus safe decoding works on root and exact declared floor Plug.Crypto 2.2.1. Supported tuple-three, legacy tuple-two and Phoenix map forms pass; nonbinary payload, invalid timestamp, unknown shape, executable terms, wrong-key/tampered values and unbounded migration ages are explicitly unsupported.
public_metadata_reader.recovery: Explicitly reject unsupported metadata forms and route affected credentials through authorized secret rotation/reprovision.
